description: Using DSA in the Real World

slides.title: Choosing the Right DS
slides.content:
# The Right Tool 🛠️

- **Need to check generic existence?** -> **Set** (O(1)).
- **Need Key-Value pairs?** -> **Dict** (O(1)).
- **Need Min/Max constantly?** -> **Heap** (O(log n)).
- **Need FIFO (Queue)?** -> **Deque** (O(1)).
- **Need to check connections?** -> **Graph**.

## Example: Rate Limiter
Prevent user from spamming API.
- Use a **Queue** of timestamps.
- Remove timestamps older than 1 min.
- If queue size > Limit, block.

slides.title: Real World Use Cases
slides.content:
# Where is this used? 🌍

- **Database Indexing**: B-Trees (Balanced Trees).
- **Google Maps**: Dijkstra / A* (Graphs).
- **Social Feed**: Graph API (Friend Connections).
- **Text Search (Ctrl+F)**: KMP Algorithm or Boyer-Moore.
- **Spell Check**: Tries or Bloom Filters.
- **DNA Sequencing**: Dynamic Programming (Edit Distance).
